title: Series
description: A commit and how it came: its base, the commits the base lacks and the files they change, as PROJECT/COMMIT/series.json (format/README.md). A series.json that lists no commits is a base's.

schema.description: The format version the file follows (format/CHANGES.md)

commit.description: The tree's commit, whole: the last of commits, or the base

message_id.description: The Message-ID of the series' first message, without <>, whose records lie under PROJECT/MESSAGE-ID/; empty for a commit that came from no message

ref.description: The ref the run was given, such as xfs-fix, for-next or v7.3; empty for a series taken by its Message-ID

trees.description: The public trees with a branch that holds commit, the one to link it to first; empty when none does

base.description: The commit the series starts from, whole

base_name.description: The directory the base's records lie under

base_trees.description: The public trees with a branch that holds base, the one to link it to first; empty when only a tag does

link.description: The commit's last Link: trailer; empty without one

cover.description: The series' cover letter: the one b4 prep keeps in the first commit of its branch, a commit that changes no file and that commits leaves out, else the first message of a series applied from a mailing list, when its subject counts it as patch 0

author.description: Name <email>, the commit's author or the message's From

date.description: The commit's author date or the message's Date, in UTC

change_id.description: b4's change-id of the series, from its tracking block or the message's change-id: line; empty without one

revision.description: The revision b4 tracks, or the vN of the message's subject; 1 without one

text.description: The commit's message after its subject, up to b4's tracking block, without the lines that start with #; or the message's body up to the --- line above its base-commit: or change-id: line, else up to its signature. Without the blank lines at either end

sources.description: The C files and headers the series changes

docs.description: The directories of Documentation with an index.rst that the series changes

lists.description: The series' mailing lists: the addresses of its cover letter's To and Cc, or of its first patch's without one, that the base's MAINTAINERS names on an L: line, lowercased and sorted; empty for a commit that came from no message
